sec.title: Chosen Brick, Iran’s Surveillance Malware
sec.brief: S. S. CISA adds Cisco Secure Email Gateway flaw to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog ENISA: Frontier AI Is Changing the Speed of Cyberattacks. S. CISA adds GitLab, JFrog Artifactory, and ConnectWise ScreenConnect flaws to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog The UK, the US, and the Netherlands published a joint advisory warning about a Windows malware family, dubbed Chosen Brick, that Iran’s intelligence services use to track down dissidents, journalists, and activists, and the stakes for the people on the receiving end go well beyond a locked file server.
